sql_reading_A.sql:
WITH students AS (
    SELECT
        s.FIRST_NAME,
        s.LAST_NAME,
        s.EMAIL_ADDRESS,
        s.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
        d.SCHOOL_NAME,
        MAX(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) OVER (
            ORDER BY s.LAST_NAME
            ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING
        ) AS MAX_DEPT_BUDGET_CODE,
        d.SCHOOL_NAME AS STUDENT_SCHOOL_NAME
    FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY s
    JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d
      ON d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s.DEPARTMENT_NAME
    WHERE s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science'
      AND s.STUDENT_YEAR LIKE 'G%'
),
subjects AS (
    SELECT
        o.SUBJECT_ID,
        o.SUBJECT_TITLE,
        o.TOTAL_UNITS,
        o.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME AS SUBJECT_SCHOOL_NAME,
        SUM(o.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (
            PARTITION BY o.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME
            ORDER BY o.SUBJECT_ID
            ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS RUNNING_SUM_TOTAL_UNITS
    FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY o
    WHERE o.TERM_CODE = '2016SP'
      AND o.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Political Science'
      AND o.TOTAL_UNITS > 1
)
SELECT
    st.FIRST_NAME,
    st.LAST_NAME,
    st.EMAIL_ADDRESS,
    st.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    st.SCHOOL_NAME,
    st.MAX_DEPT_BUDGET_CODE,
    su.SUBJECT_ID,
    su.SUBJECT_TITLE,
    SUM(su.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (
        PARTITION BY st.STUDENT_SCHOOL_NAME
        ORDER BY su.SUBJECT_ID
        ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS RUNNING_SUM_TOTAL_UNITS
FROM students st
CROSS JOIN subjects su
ORDER BY st.LAST_NAME, su.SUBJECT_ID;
